boundaries.name: domainRegistryIsTestOnly

boundaries.name: crossFileConstantValues
boundaries.obligation: Registry entries owned by other files (channel.rs, wallet_core.rs, regev, falcon_sig, channel_message.rs) are pinned at the values the test pins; no cross-file check is performed here.

boundaries.name: constAssertsAreCompileTime
boundaries.obligation: The const _ asserts are compile-time only; the model restates them as theorems about the pinned values.
